decisions.reason: As a very niche marine product that was only mentioned rather than fully presented, it looks more like a small specialist line, but a large established German lighting manufacturer would usually keep it unless demand stays weak.
A medical examination light shown on its own page fits a higher-value professional niche and is likely to be retained while the firm builds sales and references.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires are closely aligned with durable German industrial-electrical markets, so a newly launched dedicated product line would usually be kept.
Because it was relaunched as a popular designer task light and had its own page, it likely has brand value, though it is somewhat less core than the firm's specialist professional lighting lines.
